about: Text is not compared with a literal; it is tested by blank, size or in (chapter 3 § 3.7). Invalid: the agent node plan's if compares the draft with "" by ===. Valid: it tests blank of the draft.
sentences: Node 'plan' compares input.consult_draft.content (markdown_block) with a literal; text is tested by whether it is blank, its size, or in.
